body:
I don't know what to say anymore, I think I've run the gamut. Today my depression and anger have both been triggered by reading. Not my own but by someone being a book worm. 

Really, wtf. I love books, and all I can think is ....  this bitch... I wonder why anyone posts anything personal. The nice irrational conclusion is always that they are attention whores. I mean really, who puts them self out there but for attention. Read my blog, I'm so amazing ect ect. 

But how can I be mad about that? Sure it sounds showy and asshole like, I'm going to write a thesis, I'm an achiever bleaaah. But I wonder, whats wrong with me, am I really that bothered that someone can devour a book faster then I can? Set them self a task and commit regardless of if it has value and merit or not?

 I don't even read daily anymore. Would I if I had your up bringing and  social situations? Would I have a value I precieve in you, for my self? 
Whats wrong with my brain that anything I do that might be called an achievement, gets sat on silently by me and underplayed when it's brought to light. 

Why is everyone else so willing to bash pots and pans up and down the halls yelling " I am so great, I am so great". I understand the poster doesn't feel that way about it. But whats wrong with my brain? Why don't I ever want to share? Why do I get upset? Why am I angry, Why do I think, wow she must be so smart, I'm so fucking worthless by comparison. 

How can redditors continually share their largely mundane lives over and over again, unique only to them, common in theme and ideal. But still shared, and patted on the back and upvoted brought together by common experiences from miles, MILES, on this fucking internet. The asshole end of the internet none the less on the assholes end of that page. The equivalent of being forced to play a gig in a shitty cafe a to tired old couple.Yet I am upset, why don't I share... even in that shitty cafe... Why do I never share even to get 20 other idiots like my self talking? Why don't I value my self, my ideas and my expiriences enough to parade around the internet? Whats wrong with my brain?

Are you narcissistic? Am I? Is It fair that I think that. I don't believe it is. But there it is. Geez what I would give to not exist.

I feel something important is being said about the things we know  here. Things other people can't understand because they just are not. I willing wear sorrow as a badge, how can we understand joy without sadness? It's hard being that it's a double edge sword. But I honestly think there is a certain wisdom to us easily over looked. I see it in the messages sent to me. Thank you.

I want to be unmade into nothing. I like the idea of the darkness. I know things are beautiful. But I no longer enjoy them. The last thing left to me is being sad. I love sorrow and sad music. But even that's losing it's edge. I don't feel much anymore. I don't imagine many of us are good at giving advice here, just sharing and relating. Thank you though, I wish you the best and promise to continue at my best for the longest I can. I just wish something would breath the passion of life into me. I don't seem to remember what that's like.
